findings.detail: The CON-STATES-THREE / CON-STATE-PARTICLE-MODEL pair (both CORE @ 1.1) and the CON-SOLUTION triple-node are operator merge/split decisions — the same FP-2 class as the pilot yield triple. All flagged with merge notes; no defect.

Three 1.10 technique -> CON-SOLUTION edges (distillation, filtration, crystallisation): the first two are each their technique's only solution link (kept SUGGESTED), the third is subsumed (quarantined REVIEW_REQUIRED at authoring). Operator may prune the class further at the gate.
